title: Organic Potting Soil
description: Premium organic potting soil enriched with worm castings and mycorrhizae. Perfect for containers, raised beds, and indoor plants. Promotes healthy root development and vibrant growth.

title: Pure Worm Castings
description: 100% pure worm castings - nature's perfect fertilizer. Rich in nutrients, beneficial microbes, and enzymes. Gentle enough for seedlings yet powerful for mature plants.

title: Mycorrhizae Inoculant
description: Professional-grade mycorrhizal fungi blend. Establishes symbiotic relationships with plant roots, dramatically improving nutrient and water uptake. Essential for organic gardening success.

title: Compost Tea Brewing Blend
description: Specially formulated blend for brewing nutrient-rich compost tea. Contains premium compost, worm castings, kelp meal, and beneficial microbe food sources.

title: Seed Starting Mix
description: Lightweight, sterile seed starting mix designed for optimal germination. Fine texture perfect for tiny seeds. Contains coconut coir, perlite, and worm castings.

title: Raised Bed Soil Mix
description: Complete raised bed soil blend. Perfect ratio of compost, topsoil, and amendments. Ready to plant - no mixing required. Feeds plants for entire growing season.
